decisions.reason: Operator training draws on existing training staff and service infrastructure, so it costs little to keep, and it supports machine sales and customer retention, so this cheap option should stay open.
The fourth rotary axis accessory is a low-cost extension of the core milling systems that adds configurability, so holding it costs little and it complements the main machine line.

Hybrid additive post-processing is far from the core business, and only a brief mention in 2019 suggests weak traction, but additive manufacturing prospects remain uncertain and fit the firm's future-oriented strategy, so the option stays open for now while being watched closely.
The high-speed CNC milling line sits at the heart of the firm's established offer, has several models and its own page, and is a core commitment rather than a marginal option.
The automatic tool change system strengthens the firm's machines' productivity and draws on existing engineering know-how, so keeping it is cheap and strategically valuable.
